description: This file implements the Warehouse plugin for a media device management system, providing device info retrieval, device reset, front panel control, and cleanup functionalities, with external dependencies on system scripts and hardware interfaces.

classes.name: Warehouse
classes.description: Main plugin class providing device management functionalities including reset, info retrieval, front panel control, and cleanup.

classes.name: LedInfo
classes.description: Helper class for managing LED timing for front panel indication.

methods.name: getAllowedCNameTails
methods.description: Retrieves allowed CName tail strings from RFC parameters or defaults.

methods.name: resetDevice
methods.description: Initiates device reset, possibly with reboot suppression.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Collects device information via system script and populates response.

methods.name: setFrontPanelState
methods.description: Sets the front panel LED state to indicate download progress or failure.

methods.name: internalReset
methods.description: Performs internal device reset if not in production environment.

methods.name: lightReset
methods.description: Performs a hardware light reset via system script.

methods.name: isClean
methods.description: Checks if certain files/directories are clean or old based on specified age.

methods.name: onSetFrontPanelStateTimer
methods.description: Timer callback to update front panel LED state periodically.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Returns timer result for LED indication timing.
